mutants.description: Blanking is applied only to the soft-start window: the S_RUN window and its count both take the live cp_sync at pwm_rise instead of the blanked cp_delay sample.
mutants.reason: In S_RUN, a cycle where the comparator is high at high-side turn-on but was low BLANK_CLKS clocks before (or the other way round) is counted wrongly. fault_count_run_out and window_trip then differ from the blanked count.

mutants.description: The S_RUN window and its count both take the blanked comparator sample from BLANK_CLKS-1 clocks before high-side turn-on instead of BLANK_CLKS clocks before, so the run lookback is one clock short while soft start keeps the full lookback.
mutants.reason: In S_RUN, if cp_sync changes exactly BLANK_CLKS clocks before a PWM rising edge, the run window records the wrong level for that cycle. fault_count_run_out and window_trip then change.

mutants.description: Parenthesis slip in the S_RUN window update: the new sample is ORed in before the shift, so it lands in bit 1. Each sample reaches the leaving bit WINDOW_RUN-1 one cycle early, and the run window spans 15 cycles instead of 16.
mutants.reason: With a sustained overcurrent in S_RUN, fault_count_run tops out at 15 instead of 16. A trip_run of 16 never asserts window_trip, and faulted cycles leave fault_count_run_out one cycle early.

mutants.description: Parenthesis slip in the soft-start window update: the new sample is ORed in before the shift, so it lands in bit 1 and leaves at bit WINDOW_SS-1 one cycle early. The soft-start window spans 31 cycles instead of 32.
mutants.reason: With a sustained overcurrent through S_SS, fault_count_ss tops out at 31 instead of 32. A trip_ss of 32 never asserts window_trip_SS, and fault_count_ss_out drops a faulted cycle one cycle early.
